# What usql prints for the describe commands on duckdb, with dbrun's
# fixture examples. TestDescribe in drivers/dbrun_test.go writes this file.
# Do not edit it. Run the test with -update, and read the diff.

-- \dt authors
      List of tables
 Schema |  Name   | Type  
--------+---------+-------
 main   | authors | table
(1 row)


-- \dt books
     List of tables
 Schema | Name  | Type  
--------+-------+-------
 main   | books | table
(1 row)


-- \d authors
           Table "main.authors"
  Column   |  Type   | Nullable | Default 
-----------+---------+----------+---------
 author_id | INTEGER | not null | 
 name      | VARCHAR | not null | 
Referenced by:
    TABLE "books" CONSTRAINT "books_author_id_author_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(author_id)


-- \d books
            Table "main.books"
  Column   |  Type   | Nullable | Default 
-----------+---------+----------+---------
 book_id   | INTEGER | not null | 
 author_id | INTEGER |          | 
 title     | VARCHAR | not null | 
Foreign-key constraints:
    "books_author_id_author_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(author_id)


-- \di *authors*
Did not find any indexes named "*authors*".

-- \di *books*
Did not find any indexes named "*books*".
